_sources: Per spot (keyed by its cache row in table 154, without sailing_charting_ and _core): flavour = the lines live sends with the charting (rsprox captures, rev 235); location, location2 (a current duck's end, a weather troll's station spot) and a mermaid riddle's answer = the OSRS Wiki's Sea charting task list. XP: rsprox (recordings from 2025-11-26 on; launch-day ones paid less) and the Wiki.

flavour: You note the position and contents of this port task board in your charts.
This station is perfect for sorting any salvage you can pull up from shipwrecks. You make a note of it.
You note the position of the dangerous rocks in your charts.
You note the position of the wreck in your charts. Cause of sinking appears to be an oar driven through the hull of the boat to kill a surprise crab.
This stone tablet seems to be a crude recruitment poster: Crunch need strong thing for hit other thing! Tell Crunch if want hit thing for Crunch.
You note the position of the crashed glider in your charts. From what you can tell, the glider crashed because strapping gnomes to paper aeroplanes is a flawed method of long distance travel.
You note the position of the wreck in your charts. Evidence suggests all members of the crew abandoned ship shortly after leaving the Node.
You note the position of the wreck in your charts. It seems someone tried to use the rudder on this boat as an oar.
You note the position of the wreck in your charts. It looks like someone dropped the anchor through the hull of this boat.
You note the position of the corpse in your charts. You struggle to comprehend how anyone could have died quite so gruesomely in this spot.
You note the position of the dangerous rocks in your charts.
You note the position of the dangerous rocks in your charts.
You note down the dragon activity exclusion area around Crandor that the marker describes.
The wind dies down and your sails with it.
You make a note of the thorny growths on your charts. You struggle to imagine why they would grow here, and put it down to spite.
You make a note that a megashrimp is definitely active in the area, and hope never to meet it.
You make a note of the position of the wreck in your charts. You note an unusual number of sea slugs clinging to the remaining parts of the ship.
You copy the charts you find in the bottle. You note the mark of the original author, N. I. Lobachevsky, and consciously omit it from your work.
The boat has been abandoned, but otherwise seems to be completely functional. You note this down in your charts.
You chart the rock formation whilst wondering how long it will last being eroded by these seas.
You make a note of the contents and location of the sign. Most of the notice lists offenses for which you can be sent to the Fight Arena. The sign also thanks you for sailing carefully.
You drink the bottle of almost smuggled rum.
You feel slightly reinvigorated...
... and slightly dizzy too.
You drink the bottle of sorodamin's bru.
You drink the bottle of potterington's marrow wine.
The wine makes your head spin with thoughts of fields full of giant crops.
You wake up somewhere strange with your strength and mind sapped.

mermaid_guide_catherby_bay.answer: Iron med helm and bronze chainbody

mermaid_guide_rainbow_reef.answer: Bucket of sap and raw slimy eel

flavour: You drink the bottle of spinner's last gasp.
You drink the bottle of barracuda brew.
You drink the bottle of banana daiquiri.
You drink the bottle of kharazi cooler.
You feel so relaxed! It's like you're never going to move again.
You drink the bottle of dognose draught.
You can suddenly smell colours and see sounds.
You drink the bottle of the way home.
You drink the bottle of platinum rum.
You drink the bottle of light in the dark.
Someone appears to have tied a cape to a stick to make a flag. You appreciate the effort and decide to mark it on your map.
Some unfortunate trader carrying a small shipment of bananas seems to have caught the attention of the locals. You mark a banana trader exclusion zone on your map.
You mark how far this shifter made it on your map. It is concerning that anything could get this far on the Void Knights' watch.
This ship seems to have been torn to shreds by ravagers and ignited by torchers. Various pest corpses litter the wreck.
You make a note in your sailing log about the strength of the Barracuda rope.
You shudder to think what monstrosity could have removed such a large portion of this ship.
You note the position of the crashed glider in your charts. From what you can tell, the glider crashed because the pilot attempted vertical takeoff.
You make a note of the high number of tiny shrimp present here.
You find a map in the bottle that looks like it has been drawn by a very artistically challenged child. You lower your standards and copy it into your charts anyway.
Whilst the rapids swirl ominously, they don't appear to affect the currents of the water. You note down this anomaly in your charts.
There is nothing in the chest except for remarkably preserved sea charts for the local area. You copy them.
The statue inscription describes the figure as Carcinister, ruler of all crabs.
The evidence of the storm tearing this ship apart is clear from a glance. You note its location down.
The rod hums with electric power. You wonder who put this here, and note it down in your charts.
You note down the location of the beautiful shell.
The fruit on this tree seem to be infested with some sort of crustaceans, some of which scuttle away whilst you are updating your charts.
You note that the inscription on the ball suggests its name is Gnome.
The boat has been abandoned, but shows only a few signs of damage. You note this down in your charts.
You have absolutely no idea what these are doing here, but you note them down anyway.
The light sways ominously. You really don't want to find out what it is attached to. You note the location.
You drink the bottle of ogre prayer potion.
You feel closer to the gods...
... though you're not quite sure which ones.
You drink the bottle of get to the point punch.
The punch tastes pleasant...
... but a rumbling in your stomach suggests there may be after effects.
You drink the bottle of oo'glug.
The drink refreshes you, although it doesn't taste like you were actually supposed to drink it.
You drink the bottle of myths mighty mixer.
You drink the bottle of goldless asgoldian ale.
You drink the bottle of destructor's cocktail.
You drink the bottle of zogre's sloppy kisses.
You drink the bottle of creator's cocktail.
The Avatar of Creation smites you.
You drink the bottle of zul-rye beer.
This boat appears to have been constructed with a hull made from bloated toads that have since deflated.
You are not sure what has caused this odd shaped rock formation, but note it down on your charts all the same.
You note down the giant corpse. You shudder at the thought of meeting a live one of these.
Whoever left this camp left a lot of their possessions behind...
There are bodies on this ship, but none of them have any clear cause of death. It's as if they died very suddenly.
You are not sure what a Lord Marshal is, but they sure had a snazzy uniform.
This coral appears to have attracted some sort of disease. It looks very unwell.
These are snake eggs. You note that there must be sea snakes active in the area.
This huge jellyfish is amost completely motionless... You don't think it's dead though.
The poison seems to be bubbling up from below the water. A channel to the Poison Waste must have opened up down there!

mermaid_guide_porth_neigwl.answer: 2 calquat kegs, an ale yeast, one pair of oak roots, and 2 barley malt

flavour: This is a hideously large egg case. You note it down in your charts...
It appears a crate of teleport crystals were spilled on this ship, teleporting a large section of hull away from where it needed to be.
Port Tyras must ship in their halberd poles from elsewhere, but this barrel clearly never made it.
Fortunately, this mine appears to be deactivated... Probably best not to sail up the river though, as it looks to have come from there.
Someone was trying to build a ship here, but it seems they've long since given up.
You drink the bottle of captain clop's mango gin.
You drink the bottle of crystal clear water.
You drink the bottle of underground passteurised milk.
You drink the bottle of delicate elven wine.
You feel a gust of wind.
You drink the bottle of sea spray.
And wake up exactly where you were.
You get a vague recollection that you accessed your bank.
You drink the bottle of headless unicornman's heady beer.
You drink the bottle of soul juice.
You are suprised this boat floats at all, let alone as gracefully as it does.
This crate of hunter clothing and furs seems to have floated here from the east.
A kraken or two has definitely shown a recent interest in the nearby fishing colony...
Hosidius has clearly had a large drop in plough use recently.
This crane has fallen into complete disrepair.
These are eggs from the wintertoad. The species will continue!
You note down the location of the sand pit in case you end up starved of sand in the nearby area.
You drink the bottle of crocodile tears.
You note down the location of the eyes as they watch you. You don't wish to see the rock crab they are attached to.
You note down the location of the roots. The name of the bay now makes sense.
This island appears to be the property of Advisor Ghrim. Perhaps he intends to spend his retirement here?
The book is titled: 'Yak Hair Rope and Me: The Captain Ned Story'. It's surprisingly salacious, so you copy it for your personal records.
This kebbit seems to have out witted the local hunters. You make a note so you can catch it later.
These magic wards seem to be intended to confuse sailors into changing course. You note them down in your charts.
This ex-plant seems to have a magical essence lingering on it. Perhaps it would be worth trying to farm it if you could find a living cutting?
The magical spell that animates these brooms seems to have got confused and tried to sweep the salt out of the sea. You mark an area on your map to beware of low flying brooms.
It seems the boat sunk very rapidly when a stray boulder from a nearby ice troll demolished a portion of its hull. You note its position.
The sled seems to float remarkably well. If you were to drag it behind your boat, you might end up inventing a new sport.
The corpse has been pecked viciously. The nearby penguins eye you suspiciously, so you back away.
You note the location of the periscope in your charts, whilst pretending not to.
Trolls seem to have crudely attemped to create a boat out of an ice chunk. It has already begun to melt. You note this down as a bad idea.
The wind dies down and your sails with it.

mermaid_guide_kannski_tides.answer: Vial of blood, cadantine, and wine of Zamorak

flavour: You drink the bottle of fishier bladderier stout.
You drink the bottle of tangled toad's legs cider.
You drink the bottle of waterbirth blue lagoon.
You drink the bottle of fishtongue tonic.
You drink the bottle of the endless night.
You drink the bottle of exile's welcome.
You drink the bottle of suqah-free cola.
You drink the bottle of winter sun.
You drink the bottle of black lobster ale.
You drink the bottle of dwarvern wizard's stout bomb.
You drink the bottle of kgp standard issue martini.
You drink the bottle of graveyard corpse reviver.
You drink the bottle of weiss meltwater.
The wind dies down and your sails with it.
Whatever bird has settled here clearly has no regard for its life or that of its offspring. You note down to look out for boiled eggs.
You wonder if this golem is beyond repair or not. You note it down in your charts.
The bottle seems to be a model of one of the nearby wrecked ships. You note the location down.
You drink the bottle of ol' random's reddest rum.
You drink the bottle of elidinis's life water.
You drink the bottle of possible albumen.
You drink the bottle of alone at sea.
You drink the bottle of alco-sol.
You drink the bottle of portal nexus perry.
You drink the bottle of self-congratulation wine.
You drink the bottle of fish bladder stoutier.
You drink the bottle of crystal clear vodka.
You drink the bottle of spinning comp-kvass.
You drink the bottle of puzzlers poteen.
The nest seems to be full of fried strips of potato. You note this exciting idea down.
The ship seems to have been overfilled with large stones and subsequently sunk as a result.
According to the book, an atoll is a ring shaped coral island encircling a lagoon. Someone should tell the apes.
You're not sure what is making that large shadow, but you feel like it is watching you.
The tiny creatures glow blue as they swim around. You wonder if this is what gave the sea its name.
The sign proudly states there is nothing south of here, so you note that down.

mermaid_guide_aureum_coast.answer: 2 tomatoes, and one each of equa leaves, batta tin, cheese, dwellberries, onion, cabbage, and gianne dough

mermaid_guide_crabclaw_bay.answer: 3 air runes, and one each of silver ore, chisel, uncut jade, ring mould, and cosmic rune

flavour: You drink the bottle of wild wood whisky.
There is a party on your boat, and everyone worth inviting is invited.
You drink the bottle of robert's port.
The drink is very sippable... unfortunately. You down the lot.
Your stomach groans. You are suddenly famished.
And wake up somewhere strangely familiar.
You drink the bottle of monkfish bladder stout.
You drink the bottle of lunarshine.
The sign informs you that this is where the sea begins. You note it down in case it isn't a joke.
The advert describes a group of intrepid sailors known as the Barracudas. You make a note of them.
Someone clearly didn't want people to be able to dock here for free. You note the lack of a suitable place to dock at this island.
Someone appears to have vivisected a chinchompa here, with predictable results.
This dead kraken appears to be decaying very quickly. You note down what you notice about kraken weak spots.
The jail seems to have a startling lack of facilities, with most guests struggling to rate it more than 2 stars.
The ship seems to have been designed to float slightly above the water, and was subsequently sunk by a bird strike.

mermaid_guide_misty_sea.answer: Bob's blue shirt and Bob's purple shirt

flavour: This boat seems to be some sort of prop that was never intended to be seaworthy.
The wind dies down and your sails with it.
There are some unfortunate fish struggling in this tangled mess of nets, weights and seaweed.
The gemstone crab looks to have tried to escape here, but someone has collapsed the cave to trap it. Carcinister will be displeased.
You drink the bottle of impling surprise.
You drink the bottle of mystery fruit cider.
You drink the bottle of captain cat's black rum.
